caption: Agentic CLI
name: agentic_cli
description: Agent Journal's Agentic CLI extension prototype. Uses ACP's session, prompt turn, content block, tool call and permission vocabulary within OCSF. The uid 901 is a PROVISIONAL, UNREGISTERED prototype assignment: it is not reserved in the OCSF extensions registry and must not be used for a release package. Packages written against it pin this uid, this version and the compiled schema hash in run.json; readers resolve class names through that pin and refuse a mismatched assignment. Version 0.2.0-prototype moves invariant per-run facts (cli_agent, producer, capture time, contract and artifact hashes) to run.json: events reference them through journal.run_uid, journal.contract_uid and source_ref.artifact. attribution.method_id states whether candidates came from a source-reported identifier or a declared derivation rule. Version 0.3.0-prototype adds the session_context class (settings reported, context injected, accounting reported), the session_settings object, the Turn started activity of prompt_turn, the Incomplete-at-source-end parse status for a record cut off by the end of its source, and the settings/context attributes those use. Packages written incrementally by the Java writer pin this version. Version 0.4.0-prototype (FND-1, Owner decision 2026-10-22) makes cli_agent this extension's own object: it no longer extends the core ai_agent (no inherited ai_model, charter, uid_numeric or framework type enum); it declares name, version, uid, instance_uid and product. Version 0.5.0-prototype (SEM-1 candidate, 2026-10-22; its new meanings await the Project Owner's semantic approval) records the mapping rule as journal.rule_uid instead of in OCSF unmapped; adds identity_basis_id on tool_call and operation (a stream-local item identifier is not a model-facing call identifier), tool_namespace (for example an MCP server), command_line on operation (the reported command string, never parsed into argv), measurement_status_id on usage_observation (measured versus possibly the source's default) and reasoning_form_id on content_block (full reasoning versus a summary); an operation may be a standalone observation without a wrapping tool call. Version 0.6.0-prototype (SEM-CLOSE, the delegated semantic decisions of 2026-10-22; its changed meanings await the managing reviewer's binding) exposes usage in disjoint economic tranches: uncached_input_tokens replaces input_tokens (whose meaning followed each vendor), cache reads and writes are disjoint, cache_write_tiers breaks writes down, reasoning_relation_id states whether reasoning is part of output, aggregation_id (scope total or cumulative snapshot) is a facet beside scope and finality, and components[] states per component whether it was reported, derived by a declared rule or is unavailable. model_response.response_uid is optional and is only the provider's response identifier; a source-local content item is item_uid with its identity_basis_id, and activity 3 Item completed observes it without naming a response. tool_call gains activity 4 Started (an invocation the source reports as started, not the model's request) and tool_family (the source's item type, not a tool name). reasoning_form_id gains 3 Redacted. Version 0.7.0-prototype (Tier 1 foundation wave, 2026-10-22; candidate for the managing reviewer) adds measurement_status_id on usage_component: what the source establishes about each component's quantity (Measured, Possibly default, or 3 Conditional for a component derived from a possibly default operand), apart from how Journal obtained it; a Codex zero that the pinned emitter also writes when the provider omits the member is Possibly default even inside non-zero usage. Version 0.8.0-prototype (requirements consistency, 2026-10-23; candidate for the managing reviewer) rejects the assumption that a positive cumulative value establishes every contribution: measurement_status_id gains 4 Lower bound (at least this value; equality not established), and a formula result that holds only under named assumptions is the component's new conditional_value with status 3 Conditional, never the canonical value, which stays absent. Version 0.9.0-prototype (review closure, 2026-10-23; candidate for the managing reviewer) restates two descriptions without changing any attribute, enum value or shape: 4 Lower bound reads in the stated direction (the quantity is at least the value and may exceed it; a reported 100 is compatible with an actual 150; an estimate from it is only a lower bound of the charge), and 3 Conditional no longer suggests that equal prices make an estimate exact: they make the allocation between tranches immaterial to a subtotal, never recover a missing contribution. Version 0.10.0-prototype (Antigravity close-out, 2026-10-23; candidate for the managing reviewer) adds 99 Other to scope_id, whose sibling scope names a unit the source defines (for example Conversation step) and whose unit is the enclosing event's own item, so a finer source unit is never stated as a model response; and text_update_id on content_block, which states whether a block's text is an Increment of its item's text (concatenated in order) or a Snapshot that replaces earlier views, so assembling partial text needs no vendor knowledge. Version 0.11.0-prototype (Level 1 assembly and first-class MCP, 2026-10-24; candidate for review) contains the pinned MCP protocol data model: every object, union and typed map of the official 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28 JSON Schemas is a generated mcp_* object (objects/mcp/, from journal-ocsf-writer McpBindingGenerator and the binding table that embeds and extracts them), reached through tool_call.mcp and session_context.mcp (mcp_observation: protocol revision with its basis, the addressed server and tool each with its own basis apart from the reported name and arguments, and protocol_objects typed by definition and labelled complete, partial CLI projection or schema example, with the required members a projection lacks). Shared objects carry what is common across vendors and protocols: tool_definition and json_schema for declared tools, error_info with the reporting layer (JSON-RPC, tool result, CLI, process, capture) on tool_result.errors, and cost_observation quantity kinds and units so that premium requests, model cost multipliers, nano-AIU and money stay distinct (currency is now required only of money). Final assembly is recorded per event in assembly (canonical from one source, consolidated with per-field evidence and conflicts, or a supporting observation that is evidence only). session_context gains activity 4 Outcome reported (the CLI's own exit code or lifecycle state), and source_kind_id gains 3 Telemetry export, 4 CLI report file and 5 CLI log file for the further sources a final assembly declares. Final assembly: every event may carry assembly (assembly_record: role, entity, occurrence, relation, observation references, field evidence, conflicts); relation_class_id gains 8 Superseded (a provisional observation a final one of the same quantity supersedes); cost_observation gains model_ref (a per-model quantity). Version 0.12.0-prototype (D1 canonical determinism, 2026-10-24; candidate for review) gives scope 7 Child run a unit: session_context gains tool_call_uid, the tool call whose spawned child run an accounting record reports, so child-run usage reported by the parent's records (Claude Code's Agent result and task progress/notification) is queryable at that child without being added to any parent total. Version 0.13.0-prototype (R1 ratchet review, 2026-10-24; candidate for review) separates ownership from the measurement window: aggregation_id gains 3 Single response, the consumption of one model response within the scope unit that the source may leave unidentified, neither the unit's total nor a running total, so a child run's last-response usage reported with the spawning call's result is never read as the child run's consumption.
